description: This file is a complete HTML webpage that provides a user interface for visualizing and interacting with database data. It includes styles, structural layout, and embedded JavaScript for dynamic data fetching and rendering of database, table, and row data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and updates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting current selections and showing a loading indicator.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables, loading table data if needed.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a specific database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table, rendering it as an interactive table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data with support for wide content and interactive cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates an individual cell's HTML, handling nulls, objects, and long strings for expandability.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing cell content when clicked, toggling between truncated and full display.
